Class IComponentMirror.BannerPatterns

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.rtag.item.mirror.IComponentMirror.BannerPatterns
All Implemented Interfaces:

Enclosing class:

public static class IComponentMirror.BannerPatterns extends Object implements IComponentMirror.Transformation
BannerPatterns component transformation.
This transformation save any new banner pattern if it's not compatible with older server version, and bring back when it's converted into newer version.
